notes: ACCESS: curl_cffi Chrome-impersonation with a warmed Session (homepage visit first for cookies, then GET target URL) returned full SSR HTML for all targets; no Claude-specific disallow in robots.txt (checked User-agent lines for claude/anthropic/gptbot - none; only generic 'User-agent: *' blocks on /viewcart, /dynamic/, /reviews/, facet/sort query params, etc., consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's note). Stayed on tier 1 (HTTP) throughout - never needed Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome. SCOPE: Home & Kitchen / Furniture / Home Decor departments only (flipkart.com/home-kitchen sid=j9e, /furniture sid=wwe, /home-decor sid=arb), matching the prior pass's scope and the Etsy/Pepperfry marketplace-scrutiny precedent. WHAT WAS CHECKED: (1) direct URL guesses /bestsellers, /best-sellers, /home-decor/bestsellers, /furniture/bestsellers - all 404. (2) robots.txt Sitemap list -> fetched sitemap_s_store-browse.xml.gz (27,548 URLs total, 1,286 home-decor/furniture-scoped) and grepped for bestsell/best-sell/top-sell/popular/trending - zero in-scope matches (the only 'bestsellers' URL sitewide is /children-books/bestsellers, out of scope). (3) Fetched sitemap_t_tag-browse.xml.gz (1,256 URLs, 628 English) - found exactly one in-scope hit: https://www.flipkart.com/furniture/~large-furniture-bestsellers/pr?sid=wwe (title 'Large Furniture Bestsellers', facetResponse.count=15, real product grid). Investigated and EXCLUDED: this '~tag' URL pattern is Flipkart's generic auto-generated long-tail-keyword SEO landing page mechanism - the same sitemap contains hundreds of unrelated keyword tags with no connection to a Bestsellers concept (~wall-table, ~girls-chest-of-drawers, ~best-soup-makers, ~best-kitchen-chimneys, ~best-induction-cookers), it is NOT linked from the real furniture category page's navigation (confirmed: fetched /furniture/pr?sid=wwe and found zero hrefs or nav references to large-furniture-bestsellers), and it fails the brief's test #2 (does not genuinely represent a sitewide bestseller/popularity merchandising concept - it's a coincidental keyword match, same pattern as the non-bestseller tag pages). (4) Furniture and Home Decor category PLPs (/furniture/pr?sid=wwe, /home-decor/pr?sid=arb) show a per-product 'Bestseller' spotlight badge (11 occurrences) on individual product cards within the normal category grid (JSON: spotlight.value.text='Bestseller') - this is the excluded case per brief ('any page whose only signal is a badge/label on individual products rather than the page itself being a listing') and matches the Etsy/Pepperfry per-listing-badge precedent; the page itself is the ordinary Furniture/Home Decor category PLP, not a Bestsellers PLP. (5) Main nav and footer (homepage, furniture page, home-decor page, home-kitchen page) - no 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Top Sellers'/'Popular Products' nav or footer link scoped to these departments; the one footer 'Bestsellers' widget on the homepage is a generic cross-category books/fashion SEO link list, out of scope. (6) Site search 'bestseller home decor' -> generic cross-category keyword search results page (title contains 'All Categories'), excluded as a search-results page per brief. CONCLUSION: no genuine Bestsellers merchandising PLP exists for Home & Kitchen/Furniture/Home Decor on Flipkart.
